title: Neurodivergent Test
description: Explore traits of the autism spectrum, ADHD, and sensory processing sensitivity in yourself.

questions.nd_1: Loud noises, bright lights, or certain clothing textures bother me physically.
questions.nd_2: Busy social settings wear me out, and I need a long time to recover my energy.
questions.nd_3: I have very specific interests (special interests) and can spend hours talking about them.
questions.nd_4: I often feel I have to pretend or hide my true self when socializing (masking).
questions.nd_5: I tend to make repetitive movements when focused or anxious (e.g. bouncing my leg, fiddling with my fingers, stimming).
questions.nd_6: I often have trouble understanding sarcasm, jokes, or the hidden meaning in what people say.
questions.nd_7: I feel very anxious or upset when my routine or schedule changes suddenly.
questions.nd_8: I often notice patterns or small details that most people miss.
questions.nd_9: I often struggle to start tasks that involve many steps (executive dysfunction).
questions.nd_10: Sometimes I don't respond when called because I'm so absorbed in what I'm doing (hyperfocus).
questions.nd_11: I often feel very different, as if I came from another planet compared to the people around me.
questions.nd_12: I avoid eye contact because it feels very uncomfortable or intimidating.
questions.nd_13: In conversations, I often don't realize I've been dominating the talk about my favorite topic.
questions.nd_14: I have trouble recognizing my own emotions until they peak and boil over.
questions.nd_15: I'm very picky about food, often because of textures or smells I can't tolerate.
questions.nd_16: I feel my brain works so fast that my thoughts pile on top of each other.
questions.nd_17: It's very hard for me to switch from an activity I'm enjoying to another one.
questions.nd_18: I react physically (e.g. covering my ears or flinching) when I hear a sudden sharp sound.
questions.nd_19: I often rehearse and plan conversation scripts in my head before talking to people.
questions.nd_20: I feel much more comfortable expressing myself through text than face to face.

results.description: You tend to process information, senses, and social interaction in common ways.
You have some specific habits and sensitivities, but you still adapt fairly easily.
Many neurodivergent traits show up strongly in how your brain works.
